# Manage SCIM tokens

This topic describes how to create and rotate SCIM tokens in HCP Terraform. Your identity provider (IdP) uses SCIM tokens to authenticate with HCP Terraform when provisioning users and groups.

@include 'beta.mdx'

## Overview

SCIM tokens have the following characteristics:

- **Mandatory expiration**: Tokens must have an expiration date between 30 days and 1 year from the creation date.

## Create a SCIM token

1. Log in to HCP Terraform and navigate to your organization.
1. Click **Organization settings** and then **SCIM provisioning**.
1. Click **Generate SCIM token**.
1. Set an expiration date between 30 days and 1 year from the creation date.
1. Copy and save the token immediately.

After creating the token, configure your identity provider to use it for SCIM provisioning. Refer to the provider-specific configuration guides:

- [Configure Okta for SCIM](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/scim/configure/okta)
- [Configure Microsoft Entra ID for SCIM](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/scim/configure/entra-id)

## Token lifecycle

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Minimum expiration | 30 days from creation |
| Maximum expiration | 1 year from creation |
| Best practice | Set a calendar reminder 1–2 weeks before expiration |

## Rotate a token

Rotate your SCIM token before it expires to avoid downtime in SCIM synchronization.

### Step 1: Generate a new token in HCP Terraform

1. Log in to HCP Terraform and navigate to your organization.
1. Click **Organization settings** and then **SCIM provisioning**.
1. Click **Generate SCIM token**.
1. Set an expiration date between 30 days and 1 year from the creation date.
1. Copy and save the new token immediately.

### Step 2: Update your identity provider

**For Microsoft Entra ID:**

1. Sign in to the [Microsoft Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com).
1. Navigate to **Enterprise applications** and open your HCP Terraform application.
1. Click **Provisioning** > **Admin credentials**.
1. Update the **Secret token** field with the new token.
1. Click **Test Connection** to verify.
1. Click **Save**.

**For Okta:**

1. Sign in to your Okta Admin Console.
1. Navigate to **Applications** and open your HCP Terraform application.
1. Click the **Provisioning** tab and click **Edit** for the **SCIM Connection**.
1. Update the **Authorization** field with the new token value.
1. Click **Test Connector Configuration** to verify.
1. Click **Save**.

### Step 3: Verify

- Test the connection in your IdP to confirm the new token works.
- Monitor synchronization for 24 hours to confirm operations are succeeding.

## What happens if a token expires

When a SCIM token expires:

- SCIM synchronization stops.
- Users can still log in using SSO.
- Changes in your IdP are not reflected in HCP Terraform.

To restore synchronization, generate a new token and update your IdP configuration.

## Best practices

- Set a calendar reminder 1–2 weeks before token expiration.
- Store token values securely and never share them through insecure channels.
- Generate a new token before the old token expires to avoid synchronization downtime.
